text.body: nityāṃ nirañjanāṃ śuddhāṃ rāmābhinnāṃ maheśvarīm | mātaraṃ maithilīṃ vande guṇagrāmāṃ ramāramām || oṃ tatsat | rāmarūpiṇe parabrahmaṇe namaḥ | atha havaikadā ratnasiṃhāsane samārūḍhāṃ bhagavatīṃ maithilīṃ lāṭyāyanaḥ kauñjāyanaḥ khāḍāyano bhalandano vilva ailākyastālukṣya ete sapta ṛṣayaḥ pretyatāmūcuḥ | bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ | saptadvīpā vasumatī | trayo lokāḥ | antarikṣam | sarve tvayi nivasanti | āmodaḥ | pramodaḥ | vimodaḥ | sammodaḥ | sarvāṃstvaṃ sandhatse | āñjaneyāya brahmavidyā pradātri dhātritvāṃ sarve vayaṃ praṇamāmahe praṇamāmahe || atha hainānmaithilyuvāca | vatsāḥ kuśalino'dabdhāso'repasaḥ kiṃ kāmā yūyaṃ pratyapadyadhvam || te hocurmātarmokṣakāmaiḥ kiṃ jāpyaṃ kiṃ prāpyaṃ kiṃ dhyeyaṃ kiṃ vijñeyamityetat sarvaṃ no brūhi || sovāca | rāma ityakṣara dvayaṃ jāpyam | riṃ rāma ityakṣara trayaṃ jāpyam | ruṃ rāma ityakṣara trayaṃ jāpyam | reṃ rāma ityakṣara trayaṃ jāpyam | raiṃ rāma ityakṣara trayaṃ jāpyam | roṃ rāma ityakṣara trayaṃ jāpyam | etadeva hi tārakam | etadeva hi bandhanabandhanam || sārddhatisro mātrā omityatra | imāni tryakṣarāṇi japaṃstajjapati || trīṇi vai duḥkhāni | ādhyātmikamādhidaivikamādhibhautikam | imāni tryakṣarāṇi japaṃstāni praṇāśayati || viṣṇulokātpare loke sākete śubhaśaṃsini | rājantaṃ rāmacandreti japan bandhādvi mucyate japan bandhād vimucyate || iti prathamopaniṣat ||1|| parātparataro nikhilaheyapratyanīkaguṇākaro jagadādikāraṇamamitatejorāśirbrahmādi devairapyupāsyaḥ sa śrī bhagavān dāśarathireva prāpyo dāśarathireva prāpyaḥ || iti dvitīyopaniṣat ||2|| sakalajagatkāraṇabījaṃ bhaktavatsalaḥ sa eva bhagavāṃjñeyaḥ sa eva bhagavāṃjñeyaḥ || iti tṛtīyopaniṣat ||3|| te ha punarenāmūcuḥ | ṣaṭsvapi mantreṣu katamo mantro garīyān | kamabhimantrya svakaṃ kalyāṇamabhipaśyāmaḥ | tanno brūhi maheśvari || sovācainān | sarva eva mantrāḥ sukhapradāḥ śubhapradāḥ kṣemapradā dhanapradāḥ | ekamakṣaramuccāritaṃ sadājanmabhirarjitāni mahāpātakānyapi vināśayati | tatrāpi | ṣaḍakṣaro mantraḥ sarvotkṛṣṭaḥ | āśuphalapradaḥ | sarvameva vāñchitamabhipūrayati | mokṣārthī mokṣaṃ labhate | svargārthī ca svargam | putrārthī putram | dhanārthī dhanam | vidyārthī vidyām | yadyatkāmayate sarvamagrataḥ sthitamivābhipaśyati | tataḥ sa eva sarvotkṛṣṭaḥ | sa eva śivakāraṇam | sa eva jāpyaḥ || iti caturthaupaniṣat ||4|| imameva manuṃ pūrvaṃ sāketapatirmāmivocat | ahaṃ hanumate mama priyāya priyatarāya | sarveda vedine brahmaṇe | sa vasiṣṭhāya | sa parāśarāya | sa vyāsāya | sa śukāya | ityeṣopaniṣat ityeṣā brahmavidyā | teha praṇamyocuḥ | kṛtakṛtyā vayam | vidittaveditavyāḥ | pūrṇakāmāḥ | saṃśayādviyuktaḥ | tvaṃ hi mātarnūnamasmākaṃ gururasmākaṃ guruḥ || iti pañcamyupaniṣat ||5|| ||iti vālmīki saṃhitā pañcama adhyāya antargata maithilīmahopaniṣad samāptā||
